about: The Ranger's own sounds. The voice ("Autocraft Ranger", made with Voice Design, eleven_ttv_v3) is a sharp, clipped combat trooper on his helmet radio, lower and harder than the Prospector; its lines go through comm.py like the Prospector's. Ids match the game's sound names (sfx/<name>_<n>): Ranger = reports in, mdeath = death cry, gun = the rifle (one burst per shot, every 0.61 s); minigun = the Mini gun upgrade's roar (a seamless loop on each Ranger while its burst lasts); silent in its pauses.

entries.text: [crisp, over a helmet radio] Trooper on deck. Rifle's hot and ready.
[clipped, cocky] Armor's sealed. Who needs a lesson?
[sharp, eager] Boots on the ground, sir. Give me a target.
[fast, grim] Full clip, steady hands. Let's move out.
[sharp cry, cut short] They got me—!
